name: expense-tracker/backend
description: Expense tracker back-end: vanilla PHP on AWS Lambda (Bref), no framework.

scripts.test:coverage: mkdir -p build/coverage && rm -f build/coverage/clover.xml && phpunit --testsuite unit,architecture --coverage-clover build/coverage/clover.xml --coverage-text

scripts-descriptions.test: Run the unit and architecture suites
scripts-descriptions.stan: PHPStan at level max with strict rules
scripts-descriptions.cs: PHP-CS-Fixer in dry-run mode (fails on any difference)
scripts-descriptions.test:coverage: Run the unit and architecture suites and write a Clover report to build/coverage/
scripts-descriptions.coverage:check: Fail if line coverage of src/ is below 80% (an empty report fails too)
